Two are 4x4:4 and one is 2x2:2. *The 2x2:2 and one of the 4x4:4 radios may be configured for 5GHz :or 2.4GHz operation while the second 4x4:4 radio is 5GHz only. *The 2x2:2 radio may be intended for DFS scanning. :More details will probably come later. {{See also|TP-LINK Archer AX6000}} ===See also=== :[[List of 802.11ax Hardware]] *[[Mist Systems AP21]] *[[Mist Systems AP41]] *[[Mist Systems AP43]] *[[Mist Systems AP61]]
